name: Dropbox
page_total_how: Playwright render of https://www.dropbox.jobs/en/jobs/ (no filters, 2026-10-19): 'Displaying 1 to 18 of 18 matching jobs'; the 18 card ids are exactly the 18 Greenhouse ids.
notes: 18 is genuinely all Dropbox has open: the site lists the same 18, and its Emerging Talent page (/en/emerging-talent/) links 'Open roles' back to /en/jobs/. No student board exists (dropboxemergingtalent, dropboxinterns, dropboxuniversity, dropboxcampus, dropboxinc all 404). Interns appear on the main board in season.
